formula: R₀ = F₃₀ * 12 * capture; R₁ = R₀ * (1+g); Value = R₁/(r-g); Value/token = Value / circulating_supply

base_case.reading: At today's fees and the measured ~34% capture, retained revenue alone supports only a fraction of the $4.68B market cap. The thesis case is the option value: the multiple is a bet on fee growth (g) and capture (c) rising — see the sensitivity grid.
